$comment: Brand settings for Tailzu. Edit, then run `npm run build`.
name: Tailzu

color.$comment: Palettes by combination number (1-348) from Sanzo Wada's A Dictionary of Color Combinations; browse them in the brand hub (Colour tab). "primary" is the default (--<prefix>-bg, -ink, -accent ...). mode "light" puts the lightest colour in the background, "dark" the darkest. status: "placeholder" until the palettes are chosen, then "chosen".

typography.$comment: A pairing id from foundations/typography/source/pairings.json; compare them in the brand hub (Typography tab). scale is the ratio between type sizes (1.2 calm, 1.25 balanced, 1.333 bold). hand (optional) is one handwritten accent face from foundations/typography/source/handwritten.json, if the style allows it (approaches/<approach>/typography.json -> handwritten).

$why.approach: Humanist Minimal: the product is literally hand in, type out (the site draws speech as handwriting that one set word swallows); a wobbling ink line turning into calm type is that idea in this style, and it has the strongest evidence (12/14) plus a drawing engine.
$why.primary: Wada 344 (Cinnamon Buff ground, Black ink 11.95:1, Deep Lyons Blue accent 6.2:1, inkUse body): the warm amber-cream and near-black of the app and site, with the indigo of its link card as the one accent object.
$why.alt: Wada 343 (Ivory Buff ground, Vandar Poel's Blue text 6.11:1, Burnt Sienna accent): the site's pale cream with an amber-brown accent, for professional pieces (LinkedIn) that need a quieter ground.
$why.pairing: instrument (Instrument Serif + Instrument Sans + IBM Plex Mono), rated core: the site already sets its words in Instrument Sans and IBM Plex Mono, and the calm editorial serif replaces its Newsreader.
$why.hand: Caveat: the face the site already uses for spoken words; here only for the one short said-it note per piece (six words or fewer), never for headlines, body, CTAs or numbers.
